obligations.source_text: The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame.

bindings.waistband_rise_phrase: one waistband feeds a central trouser rise above a clearly readable bifurcated trouser structure
bindings.crotch_inseam_phrase: a visible crotch or inseam divides the lower garment into distinct left and right trouser legs
bindings.two_wide_legs_phrase: two wide legs move independently in the stride, with separate inner and outer edges
bindings.calf_hems_phrase: two separate hems end around the calves, one clear hem opening for each wide trouser leg
bindings.skirt_palazzo_confound_phrase: a continuous midi-skirt panel does not substitute for two legs, pleat shadow does not count as an inseam, and full-length palazzo hems cannot substitute for the cropped variant
